description: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "52C9F6AB44726017E287708E5769D91C", "You stood watch over the narrow ramps leading to Stonespire Hold, a remote mountain refuge on Sanctus where every stone carried the weight of duty.
